data.title: Panther Minerals Adopts Semi-Annual Reporting
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / November 26, 2026 / Panther Minerals Inc. ("Panther" or the "Company") announces that it has elected to rely on Coordinated Blanket Order 51-933 - Exemptions to Permit Semi-Annual Reporting for Certain Venture Issuers (the "Order") and move to semi-annual financial reporting ("SAR"). This news release is being filed pursuant to Coordinated Blanket Order 51 - 933 Exemptions to Permit Semi-Annual Reporting for Certain Venture Issuers.

The Order allows eligible venture issuers listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "CSE") to voluntarily move from a quarterly to a semi-annual financial reporting framework. The Company's fiscal year ends on June 30. Under the SAR pilot program, the Company will be exempt from filing interim financial reports and related Management's Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) for its first and third quarters.

  • Interim Period: The Company will not file an interim report for the first quarter (Q1) ending September 30 and the third quarter (Q3) ending March 31; and
  • Ongoing Reporting: The Company will continue to file audited financial statements (due within 120 days of June 30) and six-month interim financial reports (due within 60 days of December 31).

The Company confirms it meets the pilot program's eligibility criteria, which include being a venture issuer with annual revenues of no more than $10 million, having been a reporting issuer in at least one Canadian jurisdiction for at least 12 months and having ﬁled all required periodic and timely continuous disclosure documents.

The ﬁrst period for which the Company will not ﬁle an interim ﬁnancial report and related MD&A will be for the three-month period ended September 30, 2026.

About Panther Minerals Inc.

Panther Minerals Inc. is a North American critical minerals exploration company. Its portfolio includes the Rubidium Ridge lithium-cesium-tantalum property near Atikokan, Ontario, the East Brouillan property in Quebec, and an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Mesa Top uranium property in New Mexico. Panther trades on the CSE under the symbol PURR, on the OTCQB under the symbol GLIOF and on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under the symbol 2BC.

ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS

data.title: Nations Royalty Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results and Announces Alex Morrison as Chair of the Board of Directors
data.description:
Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Nations Royalty Corp. (OTCQX: NRYCF) (FSE: Y96) ("Nations Royalty" or the "Company") is pleased to report financial results for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026.

Financial Highlights

  • Six-months ended September 30, 2026 royalty revenue of C$2.64M and net income of C$0.21M, representing:
    • +382% year-over-year increase in 6 month revenues compared to C$0.55M (1H Fiscal 2026)
  • Second quarter revenues of C$0.43M
    • +21% year-over year increase compared to C$0.36M (Q2 Fiscal 2026)
  • Accrued royalty income in amounts receivable as of September 30, 2026 of C$3.29M
    • Estimate of accrued royalty income for January to September 2026 nine month period
    • Compared to 2025 Brucejack annual payment of C$1.16M
    • Compared to 2024 Brucejack annual payment of C$0.70M
  • Cash and cash equivalents of C$16.7M as of September 30, 2026 with no long-term debt

Nations Royalty is also pleased to announce the appointment of Alex Morrison as Chair of the Board of Directors effective immediately.

Derrick Pattenden, President, CEO and Director of Nations Royalty, commented: "This first half of the fiscal year represents another period of strong year-over-year revenue growth for Nations Royalty and we are pleased to report profitability through the first-half of fiscal year 2027 driven by our royalty on Brucejack. We continue to make meaningful progress with a number of Indigenous communities towards partnering with Nations Royalty on their IBA payments. We view our IBA Advisory practice as a dual engine for growth going forward as successful outcomes lead to increased interest among Indigenous groups in the partnership opportunity presented by Nations Royalty.

I would also like to congratulate Alex Morrison on his appointment as Chair of our Board of Directors. Since the inception of Nations Royalty Alex has been an invaluable source of advice and guidance for the Company, going far beyond the standard expectations of a Director. We are honored to have him as the Chair of our Board of Directors going forward."

Portfolio Update:

Brucejack (Operated by Newmont Corporation):

  • Six-month fiscal year-to-date Brucejack revenues have grown substantially compared to 1H Fiscal 2026 and Nations Royalty remains profitable through the first-half of fiscal 2027.
  • During the three months ended September 30, 2026, management updated its estimate based on additional information provided by Newmont regarding the expected BC Mineral Tax payable for the year. This resulted in lower royalty income recognized in the current quarter relative to the preceding quarter.

KSM (Owned by Seabridge Gold):

  • Seabridge announced on July 20, 2026 that it had entered into an unsecured, short-term loan agreement with a strategic investor for up to US$100 million.
  • Seabridge announced the substantial completion and successful energization of the Treaty Creek Terminal ("TCT") on August 27, 2026. The TCT is a key component of the electrical infrastructure required to support future construction and operations at KSM, and is intended to provide the project with access to hydroelectric power from BC Hydro.
  • On November 19, 2026, Seabridge reported that the Supreme Court of British Columbia had confirmed that its June 8, 2026 ruling quashed the KSM Project's substantially started designation pending the EAO's reconsideration, but that the KSM environmental assessment certificate is not affected.
  • On November 23, 2026, the Nisga'a Nation and the Tahltan Nation publicly stated their support for the KSM Project and its substantially started designation.

Premier and Red Mountain (Owned by Cambria Gold Mines):

  • Received final permits for and commenced construction on the access road to the Red Mountain Gold Deposit, the completion of which represents a key step towards production.
  • Cambria is targeting road access to the base of Red Mountain through the end of 2026.
  • Targeting completion of an updated combined Red Mountain-Premier Feasibility study in the first-half of 2027.
  • Targeting commissioning of the 2,500 tonne-per-day mill at Premier in Q4 2027.

Outlook

Nations Royalty maintains a strong financial position including C$16.7 million of cash and cash equivalents and no long-term debt.

The Company believes its diversified portfolio of producing and development-stage Indigenous royalty interests is well positioned to benefit from strength in precious metals markets and the advancement of several large-scale mining projects across northwestern British Columbia, Canada.

Management remains focused on creating value for shareholders and Indigenous partners by:

  • Expanding the Company's portfolio through partnerships with Indigenous Nations;
  • Acquiring additional high-quality royalty interests; and
  • Maintaining disciplined capital allocation.

As Canada's first majority Indigenous-owned publicly listed royalty company, Nations Royalty believes its differentiated partnership model positions it to become the preferred long-term royalty partner for Indigenous Nations participating in Canada's mining industry.

Stock Options

The Company also announces that it has granted 125,000 incentive stock options to its Director, Investor Relations, exercisable at $0.82 per share for a period of five (5) years from the date of grant. The options vest in stages over three years in accordance with the Company's stock option plan and are subject to TSXV approval.

About Nations Royalty Corp.

The Company's vision is to unite First Nations and Indigenous groups across Canada, welcoming external investors to join the Company as shareholders. Together, they will combine royalties, income and commodity streams and annual benefit payment entitlements from resource projects, tapping into the growth, diversification and value potential typical of publicly traded royalty companies. As a leader in the spirit of economic reconciliation, Nations Royalty's mission includes capacity building of Indigenous People in public companies and capital markets.

Nations Royalty's foundation begins with five annual benefit payment entitlements in place in respect of the following properties in Canada:

  • The high-grade Brucejack gold mine operated by Newmont Corporation;
  • The KSM Copper-Gold-Silver-Molybdenum deposit, currently in development by Seabridge Gold Inc.;
  • The Premier Gold Project, currently evaluating a restart decision by Cambria Gold Mines Inc.;
  • The Red Mountain Gold Deposit, owned by Cambria Gold Mines Inc.; and
  • The Kitsault Molybdenum Deposit, a large, fully permitted brownfield site owned and being actively advanced by New Moly LLC, majority-owned by Resource Capital Fund VI L.P.

On behalf of the Board of Directors of Nations Royalty Corp.

"Derrick Pattenden"

Derrick Pattenden, President, CEO and Director

data.title: LUNR Aerospace Appoints Draganfly CEO Cameron Chell to Board of Directors
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / November 26, 2026 / LUNR Aerospace Corp. (WKN:A4269V) is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Cameron Chell to its Board of Directors (the "Board"). Mr. Chell is the President, Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Draganfly Inc. , a developer of drone systems and autonomous technologies. With more than 30 years of entrepreneurial and executive experience, Mr. Chell brings an extensive background in establishing, financing and growing technology companies across aerospace, defence, autonomous systems, advanced manufacturing and public markets.1

Mr. Chell has founded and co-founded numerous technology ventures, including Engyro, an enterprise software company whose technology was acquired by Microsoft Corporation in 2007.2 He also founded FutureLink, an early developer and operator of data centres for the provision of internet-based software applications including the first to deploy enterprise level applications as the precursor to modern cloud computing services.

His experience in the aerospace sector includes co-founding UrtheCast Corp., a Canadian Earth-observation technology company that developed and deployed high-definition imaging systems on the outside of the International Space Station ("ISS"). In 2015, UrtheCast released what it described as the world's first full-colour HD videos of Earth captured from the ISS.3 The company subsequently ranked first in Deloitte's 2016 Technology Fast 50 program, recognizing it as Canada's fastest-growing technology company based on revenue growth between 2012 and 2015.4

In his current leadership roles at Draganfly, Mr. Chell oversees the publicly traded company developing unmanned aircraft systems and related technologies for commercial, public safety and defence applications. In September 2026, Draganfly announced that it had been awarded a five-year contract by the Government of Canada to supply tactical intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance drone systems to the Canadian Armed Forces.5

Mr. Chell's broader business experience also includes serving as co-founder and chairman of KODAKOne, a digital image rights management platform developed in conjunction with the Eastman Kodak Company.6 His entrepreneurial career has attracted international media attention, including Forbes7 plus television appearances involving CNN8, Fox Business9 and the RedChip Money Report on Bloomberg Television10. He has also been a featured speaker at events at the United Nations, TEDx Montréal Women, and has opened for Tony Robbins on multiple occasions sharing perspectives on entrepreneurship, technology and leadership.11

"I am pleased to join LUNR Aerospace's Board of Directors at an important stage in the Company's development. With the growing importance of sovereign space access for national security, defence and commercial applications, I believe LUNR is pursuing a significant opportunity, but more importantly, a critical mission to help establish Canadian orbital launch capabilities and address the increasing global demand for secure, reliable and cost-effective access to space. I look forward to working with the entire LUNR team to advance the Company's strategic objectives in support of Canada's critical space requirements," said Cameron Chell.

"Cameron brings extensive experience in building and leading technology businesses across aerospace, defence and autonomous systems. His proven background in commercializing emerging technologies, developing strategic relationships and navigating public markets will be a valuable asset to LUNR as we advance our propulsion technologies and orbital launch capabilities. We look forward to leveraging his experience and perspective as we execute our long-term growth strategy," stated Jeanue Chung, CEO of LUNR Aerospace Corp.

About LUNR Aerospace Corp.

LUNR Aerospace Corp. is a Canadian-based company developing orbital launch capability in Canada to support sovereign access to space and serve the global launch market. The Company is focused on advancing Canadian launch infrastructure designed to help address constrained global launch capacity and enable future payload launches from Canadian soil. LUNR's planned launch systems are being designed for low-Earth orbit, polar, and sun-synchronous missions, with an emphasis on scalable vehicle architecture, reusability, and cost-efficient deployment.

ON BEHALF OF LUNR AEROSPACE CORP.,

Vancouver, British Columbia – TheNewswire – November 26, 2026 - Femto Technologies Inc. (OTCQB: FMTOF) (“Femto” or the “Company”), a pioneering femtech company, is pleased to report that it now holds 51% of the issued and outstanding common shares of I-Rat Technologies Ltd. Planning and Implementation of Technologies and Software 2025 Ltd.), having exercised the option granted to it under the share purchase agreement signed earlier this year (refer to Femto’s news release of March 27, 2026).

I-Rat Technologies is an Israeli software company focused on the development and sales of advanced, AI-driven research and data analysis solutions with a strategic emphasis on building scalable, software-as-a-service platforms designed for global deployment. Its flagship product, i-RAT (Interactive Researcher Assistant Tool), is an AI-powered SaaS platform designed to guide users across the full lifecycle of quantitative research, integrating statistical learning, hypothesis formulation, data analysis, and automated results reporting into a single, coherent environment.

Femto paid US$250,000 cash to I-Rat Technologies’s shareholder for the additional 11% interest. The purchase price was determined through negotiations rather than by a business valuator. Femto also negotiated a reduction of the amount payable to I-Rat Technologies for the 30% equity interest subscribed for under the original share purchase agreement, from US$1,000,000 to US$750,000.

Femto Technologies Inc. (OTCQB: FMTOF) is a cutting-edge femtech company spearheading transformative advancements in wellness technology. With a strong emphasis on AI-driven solutions, Femto is dedicated to innovating products that enhance well-being through intelligent technology integration.

data.title: Australian Parliament passes government plan to reserve 20% of LNG for domestic market
data.description:
Australia's Parliament on Friday passed the centre-left Labor government's gas reservation scheme, which will require liquefied natural gas exporters to set aside up to 20% of their production for the domestic market starting in 2028.

"PASSED: We're keeping more gas here for Australians with a domestic gas reservation," Prime Minister Anthony Albanese wrote on social media following the bill's passage.

The bill cleared the Senate on Thursday night in a late sitting after the opposition Liberal-National coalition indicated it would not vote against the legislation, following Labor's decision last week to exempt the state of Western Australia from the scheme. The lower house cleared the bill on Friday morning.

Western Australia, which accounts for about two-thirds of Australia's LNG exports, already operates its own 15% gas reservation policy and is not connected to the tightly supplied east coast gas market via pipelines or shipping links.

Roger Cook, Western Australia's premier, has said the exemption would "give us certainty so we can continue to attract investment, bring on new gas supply, and create jobs."

data.title: SOMA GOLD REPORTS FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE THIRD QUARTER OF 2026
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 26, 2026 /CNW/ -- Soma Gold Corp. () (WKN: A2P4DU) () (the "Company" or "Soma") is pleased to report that it has filed its condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, and the corresponding management's discussion and analysis ("MD&A"). The Company's financial results for the third quarter of 2026 ("Q3 2026") and for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 ("YTD 2026") in comparison to the same respective periods in 2025 ("Q3 2025" and "YTD 2025") are summarized below (all amounts in CAD unless otherwise specified):

Highlights:

  • Revenue for Q3 2026 increased to $23.8 million (Q3 2025 - $18.1 million), representing a $5.7 million or 31% increase. Revenue for YTD 2026 decreased to $66.7 million (YTD 2025 - $69.0 million), representing a $2.3 million or 3% decrease.
  • Income from Mine Operations decreased by $2.3 million to $3.0 million in Q3 2026 (Q3 2025 - $5.3 million), while gross margin decreased from 29% in Q3 2025 to 13% in Q3 2026. The Company incurred higher production costs as it increased mined and milled tonnages to offset the impact of lower-than-expected average gold grades realized at the Cordero Mine. The margin reduction was mitigated by a higher average realized gold price, as shown in the Key Operating and Financial Statistics table below.
  • Adjusted EBITDA(1) was $3.0 million in Q3 2026 (Q3 2025 - $6.9 million) and $9.8 million in YTD 2026 (YTD 2025 - $28.9 million). Unadjusted EBITDA(1) was $1.9 million in Q3 2026 (Q3 2025 - $6.2 million) and $6.6 million in YTD 2026 (YTD 2025 - $27.8 million).
  • Net loss for Q3 2026 was $2.4 million compared to net income of $0.4 million in Q3 2025. Net loss for YTD 2026 was $8.4 million compared to net income of $5.2 million in YTD 2025.
  • The average realized cash margin(1) was US$1,102 per ounce ("oz") in Q3 2026 (Q3 2025 – US$1,676 per oz) and US$1,200 per oz in YTD 2026 (YTD 2025 – US$1,643 per oz).
  • Adjusted EBITDA(1) per share was $0.02 in Q3 2026 (Q3 2025 - $0.06) and $0.07 in YTD 2026 (YTD 2025 – $0.30).
  • Soma had working capital (current assets less current liabilities) of $8.9 million as at September 30, 2026 (December 31, 2025 - $17.2 million) and cash of $0.4 million (December 31, 2025 - $6.3 million). Soma had value-added tax receivables of $19.8 million as at September 30, 2026 (December 31, 2025 - $12.4 million).

Geoff Hampson, Soma's CEO, states, "We are encouraged by our production results despite the decrease in gold grade. Mill throughput during the quarter increased by 39% over the same period in the previous year, which was predominantly driven by the impact of the strike in Q3 2025. Production of gold ounces remained at similar levels period over period. Gold grade fell from 5.75 gpt to 3.98 gpt between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026 and remained consistent with the 3.99 gpt grade achieved in Q2 2026. The operations team continues to work in the higher-grade areas in the mine for the remainder of 2026 and beyond, and the mining method is being adapted to the narrower veins to reduce dilution. Gold equivalent ("AuEq") ounces produced during the quarter were 4,224, compared to the budget of 7,605 AuEq ounces, as feed material delivered from the other small mines on the Company's property and third-party ore ("TPO") has been lower than expected. Accordingly, we have made investments specifically to grow the TPO business in 2027. We are also looking for areas to reduce costs and ramp up production efficiently. As we successfully execute these initiatives, we expect the Company's attributable cash costs per ounce to decrease."

Hampson further states, "The team in Colombia continues to refine operations and to be more selective in what is mined given the lower grade and gold price. This may result in fewer tonnes in the short term but will increase the average grade. Third-party ore supply and formalized small miners will also increase mill throughput. As the Nechi mine comes on stream in 2027, we expect to fully utilize our milling capacity."

KEY OPERATING AND FINANCIAL STATISTICS

QUALIFIED PERSON STATEMENT

Mr. Chris Buchanan, P.Geo, is Soma's Vice-President, Exploration and a Qualified Person as defined by National Instrument 43-101. Mr. Buchanan has reviewed and approved the technical and scientific information disclosed in this news release.

ABOUT SOMA GOLD

Soma Gold Corp. () is a mining company focused on gold production and exploration. The Company owns two adjacent mining properties in Antioquia, Colombia, with a combined milling capacity of 675 TPD (Permitted for 1,400 TPD). The El Bagre Mill is currently operating and producing. Internally generated funds are being used to finance a regional exploration program.

With a solid commitment to sustainability and community engagement, Soma Gold Corp. is dedicated to achieving excellence in all aspects of its operations.

The Company also owns an exploration property near Tucuma, Para State, Brazil that is currently under option to Ero Copper Corp.

data.title: Canadian Uranium Corp. Announces $3,000,000 Flow-Through Private Placement
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

Vancouver, British Columbia – November 26, 2026 – TheNewswire - Canadian Uranium Corp. (CSE: CANU; OTCQB: CANUF; FWB: A41WE6) (the “Company” or “Canadian Uranium”) is pleased to announce a non-brokered private placement of up to 3,000,000 flow-through common shares of the Company (the “FT Shares”) at a price of $1.00 per FT Share for aggregate gross proceeds of up to $3,000,000 (the “Offering”).

The Company has engaged Interward Asset Management Ltd. (dba Bunt Markets) (“Bunt”) to act as finder on a “best efforts” basis and, together with ECM Capital Advisors (“ECM”), as financial advisor to the Company in connection with the Offering.

The FT Shares will each be issued as a “flow-through share” within the meaning of subsection 66(15) of the Income Tax Act (Canada) (the “Tax Act”). The FT Shares will be offered by way of the “accredited investor” exemption under National Instrument 45-106 – Prospectus Exemptions in all provinces of Canada. The Offering may close in one or more tranches.

The gross proceeds from the Offering will be used to incur eligible “Canadian exploration expenses” that qualify as “flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures” (as such terms are defined in the Tax Act) on the Company’s Saskatchewan uranium portfolio, which will be renounced to subscribers in accordance with the Tax Act.

“We are very happy to be engaging and working with Bunt and ECM on this financing,” said Geoff Balderson, Chief Financial Officer of Canadian Uranium. “The use of proceeds will be deployed into our very exciting Saskatchewan portfolio of top-tier uranium assets.”

In connection with the Offering, the Company has agreed to pay Bunt a cash commission of up to 8.0% of the gross proceeds from the sale of FT Shares to purchasers introduced by Bunt, and to issue to Bunt finder’s warrants (the “Finder’s Warrants”) equal to up to 8.0% of the number of FT Shares sold to such purchasers. Each Finder’s Warrant will be exercisable for a period of two years from the date of issue at an exercise price of $1.50.

All securities issued under the Offering will be subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance. Completion of the Offering is subject to certain conditions, including the receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals and acceptance by the Canadian Securities Exchange (“CSE”).

This news release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities in the United States. The securities have not been and will not be registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from such registration requirements.

Through disciplined acquisitions, innovative exploration methodologies, and strategic partnerships, the Company aims to accelerate project advancement and unlock value across its exploration portfolio.

data.title: US House Panel Advances Bitcoin Reserve Bill With 20-Year Holding Rule
data.description:
The US House Financial Services Committee has advanced a bill that would put the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into federal law and require the Treasury to hold Bitcoin deposited in it for at least 20 years from enactment.

The committee reported H.R. 8957, the American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026, with amendments on November 24. The bill was placed on the House Union Calendar, a step that makes it eligible for floor consideration. It still needs to clear the House and Senate and be signed into law. Alaska Republican Rep. Nick Begich introduced the measure in May.

What Treasury could do with the reserve

The bill would direct qualifying Bitcoin already owned by the federal government into the reserve and qualifying non-Bitcoin assets into a separate Digital Asset Stockpile. Treasury would administer both. The bill says reserve assets could not be “sold, swapped, auctioned, encumbered, or otherwise disposed of” during the minimum holding period. The restriction starts on the date the law takes effect and applies to Bitcoin acquired by the US and deposited in the reserve, regardless of how the government obtained it.

Two years before the holding period ends, Treasury would have to recommend whether to keep holding the Bitcoin or allow a gradual release. Once the period expires, the secretary could recommend selling up to 10% of the reserve’s assets in any two-year period.

The bill separately gives Treasury a year from enactment to study when an early sale might be appropriate and recommend any changes to the law, including possible exceptions for national security or financial stability. That study would leave any decision to create an exception with Congress.

How it builds on the 2025 executive order

President Donald Trump established the reserve and stockpile by executive order in March 2025. The order used eligible forfeited Bitcoin as the basis for the reserve and directed the government to retain Bitcoin deposited in it. It also authorised Treasury and Commerce to develop strategies to acquire additional Bitcoin without imposing incremental costs on taxpayers.

The House bill would set the holding rule in statute and create reporting and public proof-of-reserves requirements. It would also give Treasury and Commerce 180 days to study whether the government could acquire more Bitcoin in a way that avoids increasing the national debt. The bill calls for a study and sets no purchase target or acquisition schedule. A separate proposal from Sen. Cynthia Lummis would authorise the government to acquire an additional one million Bitcoin.

The next step is a House floor vote. The Block reported that the approaching end of the 119th Congress leaves limited time for both chambers to act.
